question: The evidences of the Mauryan Empire are quoted in the texts of Megasthenes who was an ambassador in the court of:
solution:
The correct answer is __**Chandragupta Maurya.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The evidence of the Mauryan Empire are quoted in the texts of Megasthenes who was an ambassador in the court of Chandragupta Maurya.
 
• The Greek traveller Megasthenes visited the court of Chandragupta Maurya.
 
• Megasthenes is an ambassador of Seleucus I Nicator to Chandragupta Maurya in Pataliputra.
 
 
• Indica is a book written by Megasthenes.
 
• It describes the administration and society during the time of Mauryas.
 
 
 
• He migrated to Shravanabelagola along with the Jain monk Bhadrabahu.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Ashoka (268 to 232 BC):
 
 
• He was the son of Bindusara.
 
• His other names were Devanampiya and Piyadasi.
 
• He was coronated to the throne in 268 BC.
 
• He was famous for the battle of Kalinga, fought in 261 BC.​
 
 
 
• Bindusara was the son of Chandragupta Maurya and father of the King Ashok.
 
 
• He ascended the throne in 298 BC after his father.
 
• He had so many names mentioned in the various text.
